race.description: Hunter Valley Premium Meats Bowman Sprint Hcp
race.comment: LIGHTHOUSE LASS (6) has excellent metro form herself. In fact, she won a Saturday race at Rosehill. Only thing would be will she be giving away too much start over the 900m? SARATOGA POWER (2) is resuming from a spell and absolutely flies at this course. That will hold him in good stead, just whether he is up to this. Each-way. SPECK (4) scored over 950m at Moree two back then missed the frame last time out over 1000m at Taree. Usually thereabouts and worth including in all wider plays. SHIHAB (1) is resuming following a winning trial, looks a fair chance in this suitable race. ARCTIC LEGEND (5) finished fourth over 1500m at Eagle Farm two months ago. In the mix.
